title: Governed pre-inference plan and managed execution publication
intent: Use .decapod/governance/plan.json as the automatic pre-inference sketchpad for ideating a target solution and converging on human intent; require plan, claims, trajectory, and validation receipts in every published validation-output change; keep living specs and the Decapod execution Dockerfile under .decapod/managed; publish stable -debian and -alpine image families, with Debian Bookworm as the current glibc base.
proof_hooks: cargo test --test infer_precision --test activation_conformance --test plan_governed_execution --test release_workflow_policy
